personality_one_liner: A calm, luxury editorial experience where generous space and elegant typography frame the intricate details of custom jewelry.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Treat the interface like a luxury magazine. Ensure intentional padding around content, leaving empty areas to spotlight the jewelry.

do's: Use frosted glass over photo backdrops for featured category cards.
Use for sticky bottom CTAs (Add to Bag / Save Design) when scrolling content underneath.
dont's: Do not use on form inputs or small list rows.
Do not over-blur; maintain a calm editorial feel.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Introduce the luxury aesthetic and guide the user to select a jewelry type to start building.

states.loading: Centered minimalist spinner in Antique Gold.
states.error: Elegant text message 'Unable to load collections' with a thin outlined 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero banner at the top with a vertical gradient scrim and large Playfair Display title. Below, a 2-column elegant grid for categories (Necklace, Bracelet, Ring, Earrings). Each category card uses a high-quality image with a soft gradient overlay and serif title.

screens.name: Build
screens.purpose: Allow users to configure their jewelry piece with a live SVG preview and running price.

states.loading: Fading skeleton layout for the canvas and configuration chips.
states.error: Error loading configurator. Display retry button.

screens.layout: Top 45% of screen is a fixed canvas showing the react-native-svg preview. Bottom 55% is a scrollable area for step-by-step selectors (Base style, metal color chips, size sliders, charms, engraving input). Includes a sticky bottom CTA at the root containing the running price and a 'Save Design' button.

screens.name: Saved
screens.purpose: A beautifully spaced archive of the user's bespoke designs stored locally.

states.empty: Luxury lifestyle image with 'Your collection is empty' and a 'Start Designing' primary CTA.
states.error: Error loading saved items with a retry button.

screens.layout: Grid or list of saved designs using generous spacing. Each item displays the piece's name, configured metal, and estimated price. Tapping an item opens a Detail view sheet.

screens.name: Design Detail (Sheet/Modal)
screens.purpose: Display saved design specifics, providing options to add to bag, request quote, or tease Try-On.
screens.layout: Pops up over the Saved screen. Shows a large rendering of the design, a breakdown of components and cost, a primary 'Add to Bag' button, and a secondary banner teasing 'Try On (Coming Soon)' with a subtle icon.

hero_home.alt: Luxury minimalist jewelry lifestyle with earrings and dark contrast elements

category_necklace.alt: Minimalist gold necklace on cream background

saved_empty_state.alt: Clean minimalist paper and luxury lighting

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT' layout rules. No thick borders, no heavy shadows. Use generous margins and padding to create a calm, luxury feel.
The color palette revolves around cream and gold. Never use indigo, blue, or purple anywhere in the UI.

For the 'Build' screen, the upper portion should be a react-native-svg canvas that dynamically redraws as the user updates configuration state. The lower portion will house all controls (metal color, size, charms, engraving).
Ensure that when rendering text over image cards (like Home categories), a vertical top-to-bottom gradient scrim is applied to guarantee readable contrast.
Implement a sticky 'Save Design' CTA with the running total at the bottom of the Builder screen, ensuring safe-area clearance and floating above the scrollable configuration options.
Include a 'Try On (Coming soon)' teaser prominently but elegantly within the saved design detail modal/sheet.
